description: In Odisha, 33.0% of women aged 15 to 49 had 10 or more years of schooling in NFHS-5 (2019-21) and 43.9% in NFHS-6 (2023-24): up 10.9 points, twice India's rise of 5.4 (41.0% to 46.4%). For men, Odisha rose 10.5 points against India's 4.4.
